chunks: But they called their commander, who seized and hamstrung her.
ai.seo_question: Who did the people of Qamar call to kill the camel and what did he do?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the decisive action of their leader, often identified as Quthmur or the chief of the tribe, who executed the she-camel to mock the divine sign. This act of 'hamstringing' (faqara) signifies a complete severance of vitality, marking the culmination of their arrogance and leading directly to the divine punishment described in the subsequent verses.
